rows.item: Historical NFL Player Prop Closing Lines & Over/Under Vig
rows.reason: Official NFL.com publishes player box-score statistics, and Genius Sports distributes commercial betting feeds (SL-SRC-16), but no free official archive of historical player-prop closing lines or vig exists. All prop-combo ROI cells (STR-12..STR-14) are left blank and held at Gate G10.

rows.item: Sportsbook Same-Game Parlay (SGP) Proprietary Correlation Haircut Schedule
rows.reason: DraftKings KB0010719 confirms SGP odds are priced differently from independent parlays, but operators do not publish historical SGP pricing matrices. STR-10 and STR-11 leave verified ROI blank and report only box-score joint hit rates and fair Gaussian-copula odds.

rows.item: Point-in-Time Opening Lines & Closing-Line Value (CLV) Timestamp Series
rows.reason: Committed games.csv.gz records a single closing spread/total without opening-line timestamps or multi-book consensus snapshots; CLV edge is therefore left blank rather than simulated.

rows.item: Funded Real-Money Leaderboard Prize Pool & Sportsbook Account Limits
rows.reason: While NFL Big Data Bowl awards $100,000 externally (SL-SRC-17), this repository has no funded cash treasury or verified sportsbook execution limits; cash prize cells are blank and competition rewards are tracked strictly in non-monetary paper points (0 awarded because 0 strategies passed all 10 gates).

rows.item: 2026 Week 8 Monday Night Football Final Score (Bears at Seahawks, Nov 2 8:15 PM ET)
rows.reason: Verified on NFL.com Week 8 schedule as kicking off Monday, Nov 2, 2026 at 8:15 PM ET; final score does not yet exist at verification time on 2026-11-02 UTC.

rows.item: Committed games.csv.gz Missing 12 Settled Sunday Nov 1, 2026 Week 8 Final Scores
rows.reason: Committed data/derived/games.csv.gz ends at Oct 29 TNF (CAR@GB), leaving 24/32 club records stale vs 2026-11-02 NFL.com standings. Skill Lab verified all 12 Nov 1 finals directly from NFL.com and proved 32/32 exact standings reconciliation without overwriting shared data/ files.

rows.item: data/standings_2020.csv Conflates Regular-Season & Playoff Games + Uses 'OAK' for 2020 Raiders
rows.reason: Sibling file data/standings_2020.csv reports 19-20 game totals (e.g. KC 16-3, BUF 15-4) as 2020 standings whereas official NFL.com 2020 REG standings are 16 games (KC 14-2, BUF 13-3, LV 8-8).

rows.item: Spread Sign Convention Inversion vs Standard Sportsbook Display
rows.reason: In games.csv.gz, spread_line > 0 denotes a HOME favorite (proved by 100% shorter home moneyline for spread_line >= 3), opposite to standard sportsbook display (-3.5 = favorite, SL-SRC-18). Skill Lab converts every published line to standard Home Handicap (-spread_line).

rows.item: Ex-Post WR1 Selection Bias in Earlier Correlation Tables (r = 0.62 vs Ex-Ante r = 0.38)
rows.reason: Selecting a team's 'WR1' by who led the game in receiving yards ex-post inflates QB-WR1 correlation from r = +0.3779 (strictly ex-ante target-share leader) to r = +0.6172 (lookahead bias, Issue #19).

rows.item: 1,902 Pre-2018 Spread Rows Missing Recorded Odds in games.csv.gz
rows.reason: 1,902 settled games (1999-2017) have spread_line without home_spread_odds/away_spread_odds. Skill Lab never imputes -110; all priced strategy backtests use 2018-2026 rows with 100% real odds.

rows.item: Root/Docs Triple Executive-Summary Drift & Issue #34 Provenance Path Bug
rows.reason: README.md, EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY.md, and docs/EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY.md summarize three distinct builds (7, 5, and 9 strategies), and scripts/analysis/build_site.py:608 reads results/provenance.json instead of data/provenance.json. Logged in COORDINATION.md without editing sibling-owned files.

rows.item: Historical Closing Odds Originate from Third-Party Community Feed (nflverse), Not NFL.com
rows.reason: NFL.com verifies scores, standings, schedules, and player stats (64/64 team-seasons & 7/7 players matched), but does not publish an archive of historical closing spreads/moneylines (SL-SRC-16).
